title: Roamhaven Rewards Membership Status, Suspension and Closure
content:
## Terms

**Enrollment.** A guest of at least the programme's minimum enrollment age enrolls in Roamhaven Rewards in the starting tier, and confirms through the programme's enrollment verification within the confirmation period in calendar days, or the enrollment closes. A new membership stands as pending confirmation until the guest confirms; on confirmation the membership becomes active and its last activity date is set to the confirmation date.

**Suspension.** A membership is suspended only on one of the programme's suspension grounds, and only by Roamhaven's review team. While the membership is suspended, and the tier's terms freeze credits during a suspension, nothing is earned, redeemed or reinstated.

**Lifting a suspension.** A suspension is lifted only when the review clears the member, within the review period in business days. When the review clears the member, support lifts the suspension and the membership is active again.

**Closure on review.** A review that upholds the breach closes the membership.

**Closure by the guest.** The guest may close an active membership.

## States

| State | Reached from | How |
|---|---|---|
| Pending confirmation | Enrollment | The guest enrolls |
| Active | Pending confirmation | The guest confirms enrollment through the emailed link |
| Closed | Pending confirmation | Enrollment was not confirmed in time |
| Suspended | Active | The membership is frozen for a fraud review or a terms breach |
| Active | Suspended | The review cleared the member and support lifts the suspension |
| Closed | Active | The guest closes the membership |
| Closed | Suspended | The review upheld the breach and the membership is closed |

## Points of judgement

| Membership | Earning, redemption and reinstatement of credits |
|---|---|
| Suspended, with credits frozen during suspension | None of the three takes place |

| Review outcome | Membership afterwards |
|---|---|
| Clears the member | Suspension lifted; active |
| Upholds the breach | Closed |
